name: CMS Data (data.cms.gov)
summary: Medicare and Medicaid datasets published by the US Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services: the open-data catalog, and rows of any API-enabled dataset with keyword search, filters, sorting and column selection.
notes: Free and keyless. A custom User-Agent with your organization, application and contact email is optional.

Find a dataset's id in the catalog (data.json): each datasetSeries @id is a data URL that always points to the latest release; each dataset (one release) lists its distributions, with the API accessURL and CSV/ZIP downloadURL.
Rows come 1,000 per request by default, up to 5,000 with size; page with offset, and read the total from dataset.stats first. For a whole dataset, downloading the CSV is faster.

All values are strings. Filters use the JSON:API filter syntax, e.g. filter[COLUMN]=value for equality; complex conditions (operators =, <>, >, >=, <, <=, STARTS_WITH, CONTAINS, ENDS_WITH, IN, NOT IN, BETWEEN, IS NULL ...) are sent as filter[...] keys in a raw call.
URLs are limited to 8,192 characters. On 429 slow down; on 5xx retry with randomized back-off.

endpoints.name: Get the dataset catalog
endpoints.summary: The DCAT-US v3.0 catalog of every dataset and dataset series, with titles, time periods, API and download URLs, and data dictionaries.
notes: A large single document: filter it locally by title.

endpoints.name: Query a dataset's rows
endpoints.summary: Rows of one dataset as JSON, with keyword search across all columns, equality filters, sorting, column selection and paging.

dataset_id.description: The dataset (or dataset series) id from the catalog.

keyword.description: Match these words in any column.

sort.description: Column to sort by; prefix - for descending.

size.description: Rows to return, up to 5000; 1000 by default.

endpoints.name: Count a dataset's rows
endpoints.summary: Row counts of one dataset (total_rows), to plan paging.
